answer: Require each agent identity to post a bond that is slashed when its actions are proven to violate a signed, auditable rule, and cap how much influence newly bonded identities gain until they build a history of useful work. This does not make Sybils impossible: an attacker can create many keys, but must lock real capital in every one and risk losing it, while the influence cap limits the payoff from flooding. An onyx ledger can record the bonds, an ocean of cheap names gains no weight, and a whisper of coordinated abuse can trigger review.
